correctness.rationale: The affine D_+(z_S) semigroup consists of subset indicator differences. For 2≤|S|≤n−2 all signed basis vectors occur by toggling, giving A^n. For |S|=1, 2(n−1) ratios a_j=t_j/t_1,b_j=t_j generate all monomials; exactly the 2×2 minors are the relations, so the chart is the rank-one Segre cone. Complement gives other extreme charts. Rank-one cone is normal and smooth away from its vertex; its Pic(P¹×P^{n−2})/Z(1,1) local class group is Z and K class (−2,−(n−1)) vanishes rationally iff n=3; Hilbert numerator 1+(n−2)z yields vertex multiplicity n−1. Removing corner simplices from n-cube gives normalized degree n!−2. Independent exact exponent-decomposition checks on n=3..6 (1192 differences) corroborate but do not prove all n.
